source_text: Haec est fides, quae paucis uerbis tenenda in symbolo nouellis christianis datur. quae pauca uerba fidelibus nota sunt, ut credendo subiugentur deo, subiugati recte uiuant, recte uiuendo cor mundent, corde mundato quod credunt intellegant.
thought_title: The purpose of the creed's few words
orientation: Augustine is concluding the treatise by explaining why the creed is given to new Christians in few words.
pass_a_gloss: This is [the] faith, which in few words to be held in [the] symbol to new Christians is given. which few words to [the] faithful known are, so that by believing they may be subjected to God, [having been] subjected rightly they may live, by rightly living [the] heart they may cleanse, [with the] heart [having been] cleansed what they believe they may understand.

choices.english: to be held in the creed
choices.why: The glossary requires 'creed' for symbolum, and tenenda carries the sense of holding fast to a rule of faith.
rejected: to be kept in the baptismal symbol
to be maintained in the symbol

choices.why: Nouellis means new or recent, fitting catechumens receiving the creed.

choices.english: they may be subjected to God
choices.why: Subiugo means to bring under a yoke; the passive subjunctive expresses purpose after ut.
rejected: they may be yoked to God
they may be made subject to God

choices.english: by living rightly they may cleanse the heart
choices.why: The ablative gerund expresses means, and mundent is a purpose subjunctive continuing the chain.
rejected: living rightly they may purify the heart
by right living they may clean the heart

choices.english: with the heart cleansed they may understand what they believe
choices.why: The ablative absolute corde mundato gives the condition for understanding, and intellegant completes the purpose chain.
rejected: the heart having been cleansed they may understand what they believe
with a cleansed heart they may grasp what they believe

pass_b_english: This is the faith that is given to new Christians in a few words to be held in the creed. These few words are known to the faithful, so that by believing they may be subjected to God, by being subjected they may live rightly, by living rightly they may cleanse the heart, and with the heart cleansed they may understand what they believe.
